tools.name: split_beams_by_columns
tools.description: Split structural beams at columns (pyRevit: Cutbeambycolumn). Recreates location-curve segments; not a solid cut. Params: beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; columns fall back to all in model), limit (default 50, max 200). Lengths in mm.

tools.name: split_floors_by_beams
tools.description: Split floors along beam edges and add column openings (pyRevit: Cutslabbybeam). Recreates planar floor regions; not a solid cut. Params: floorIds[], beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; beams/columns fall back to bbox hits), limit (default 50, max 200). Skips sloped/curved. Lengths in mm.
